description: This file defines a React component SidebarList for rendering and managing a sidebar with channels and categories, including drag-and-drop, scrolling, and keyboard navigation features in a Mattermost web application.

classes.name: SidebarList
classes.description: A React component for displaying and managing a list of channels and categories in the sidebar, with drag-and-drop, scrolling, and keyboard navigation.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up keyboard event listeners when the component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes keyboard event listeners when the component unmounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates when component props change, such as resetting scroll or closing sidebar.

methods.name: getDisplayedChannelIds
methods.description: Returns an array of IDs of currently displayed channels.

methods.name: getDisplayedStaticPageIds
methods.description: Returns an array of IDs of static pages displayed.

methods.name: setChannelRef
methods.description: Stores or deletes a reference to a channel DOM element.

methods.name: getFirstUnreadChannelFromChannelIdArray
methods.description: Finds the first unread channel ID from a list of channel IDs.

methods.name: handleScrollAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Updates scrollbar position during spring animation.

methods.name: scrollToFirstUnreadChannel
methods.description: Scrolls to the first unread channel.

methods.name: scrollToLastUnreadChannel
methods.description: Scrolls to the last unread channel.

methods.name: scrollToChannel
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific channel by ID, with optional unread scrolling behavior.

methods.name: scrollToPosition
methods.description: Animates scrolling to a specific position.

methods.name: updateUnreadIndicators
methods.description: Updates visibility of unread indicators based on scroll position and dragging state.

methods.name: getFirstUnreadChannel
methods.description: Returns the first unread channel ID.

methods.name: getLastUnreadChannel
methods.description: Returns the last unread channel ID.

methods.name: navigateById
methods.description: Navigates to a channel or static page by ID.

methods.name: navigateChannelShortcut
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts for navigating channels.

methods.name: navigateUnreadChannelShortcut
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts for navigating unread channels.

methods.name: renderCategory
methods.description: Renders a sidebar category component.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Debounced handler for scroll events to update unread indicators.

methods.name: onTransitionEnd
methods.description: Debounced handler for transition end events to update unread indicators.

methods.name: onBeforeCapture
methods.description: Prepares state before starting a drag operation.

methods.name: onBeforeDragStart
methods.description: Sets dragging state before drag starts.

methods.name: onDragStart
methods.description: Handles logic when dragging begins, including setting dragging state.

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: Handles logic after drag ends, including moving channels or categories.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the sidebar list with categories, unread indicators, and scrollbars.
